snapshot.text: Single-payer system run by the Estonian Health Insurance Fund (Tervisekassa), financed mainly by payroll tax. The fund has run deficits for years, and how to fund healthcare sustainably is the central policy debate.

priorities.title: Closing the health fund deficit
priorities.text: The health fund's 2026 budget deficit came in smaller than forecast, but funding remains the main open question.

priorities.title: Doctor fees and preventive care
priorities.text: The health fund plans updates to doctor fees and more preventive care.
